text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Mejiro Palmer—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh! There's something that looks fun!

Looking in the direction Mejiro Palmer 
pointed, there was a crane game filled 
with stuffed plushies modeled after 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Nice, super cute! Oh, there are some I've 
never seen before too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Actually, Helios and I play these kinds of 
games a lot too, y'know? Just the other 
day, we won a super huge one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Helios turned it into a phone strap, and 
then started freaking out 'cause it 
wouldn't fit in her bag! It was so 
hilarious!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
With a plushie around this size, hanging 
it from my bag might actually work.
choice_data_list: Let's grab it and try putting it on!
Let's grab it and put it on!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Trainer, are you all fired up? Look at 
you being so dependable!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll leave this to you! Palmer-san 
will be watching over you~!
—I can't afford to lose this game!!
